Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 7: the slip of [[Death Star Gunner (V) (Errata 4)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E4 (“While on Death Star: cancels Force drain bonuses from Death Star sites' game text, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to ▲ Superlaser.”), word for word the text of [[Death Star Gunner (V) (Errata)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
